run.notes: All 19 prompts produced answers and were manually reviewed. This is a complete task execution with 17/19 critical-rubric passes, not a clean release pass. No total token cap was predeclared. Two closed tasks have failed local read attempts due unavailable PowerShell/Node runtime; one live answer fails official-source citation; one live migration answer omits macOS/Xcode for iOS. Search/tool traces show 24 web_search calls and unusually high input usage.
